title: If Saitama Was in Jujutsu Kaisen
original_title: If Saitama Was in Jujutsu Kaisen
overview: A 26-minute fan-made animated film that reimagines Saitama in the world of Jujutsu Kaisen. As the strongest hero enters the realm of curses and sorcerers, unexpected encounters, intense battles, and comedic moments unfold.
